title: Tests pin the render-stale flag after a failed wizard render and after a move
lead: Two places in s279 that mark the render drift as due get a test that fails when the line is deleted.
findings_note: s279 gate non-blocking note, nested-relay trial 2026-10-15

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The s279 gate (nested-relay trial, 2026-10-15) passed with a non-blocking note. `test_Status_AfterWizardSave_NotRenderStale` would still pass if the `self.drift_due = True` after the wizard's render (`src/slicer/tui.py:984`) were deleted. The view opens on a fresh render and the earlier `refresh` has already cleared `drift_due`, so on a successful render the stale flag is false either way. Only a failed render needs line 984 to bring `render stale` back. The move prompt's `self.drift_due = True` (`src/slicer/tui.py:1045`) has no test. Note edits and handoff are covered by `test_Status_AfterNoteEdit_ShowsRenderStale` and `test_Status_AfterHandoff_ShowsRenderStale`.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - `tests/test_tui.py`, next to the `test_Status_*` tests. Tests only; `src/` does not change unless a test shows a real defect, which stops and goes back to the owner.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
These are pinning tests. They pass on the current code, so "red" means a mutation check: each test must fail with its line deleted.
- `test_Status_AfterWizardSave_RenderFails_ShowsRenderStale`: the wizard-save sequence from `test_Status_AfterWizardSave_NotRenderStale`, with the render forced to fail (for example `mock.patch.object(tui, 'act')` returning an error outcome for `r`, or another failure the test can cause without touching the user's files). The message names the render failure, and after `view.refresh(state)` the status shows `render stale`. Deleting `tui.py:984` must turn it red.
- `test_Status_AfterMove_ShowsRenderStale`: in a rendered repo with two items, the move prompt moves the first item to position 2. After `view.refresh(state)` the status shows `render stale`. Deleting `tui.py:1045` must turn it red.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the two tests and run them green.
2. Mutation check, with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1: delete each line, confirm its test goes red, then restore the line.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s295`, branch `feature/s295-drift-flag-tests`. Commit only on the branch. Merging and pushing wait for the owner.
